notes: New-game home state (task 32d). 'empty' strips the home lot of furniture and appliances (walls, doors, windows, floors, ceiling lights, the mailbox and the yard's pond/garden stay) and adds starter money by home size. Free Play and every scenario can use either. 'furnished' is the old start.

options.label: Empty home (furnish it yourself)
options.desc: Bare walls and floors plus extra coins for a bed, toilet, shower, fridge, stove and seats. Press B to buy.

options.label: Furnished home
options.desc: Move into a home that already has its furniture.

basics.text: Buy a bed so your Folk can sleep properly: press B, open Bedroom, pick a bed and click a spot in the bedroom.
Next, a toilet: press B, open Bathroom and place a Toilet in the bathroom.
Now a fridge for food: press B, open Kitchen and place a Fridge. Then add a stove.
A shower keeps everyone fresh: press B, open Bathroom and place a Shower.
A stove lets your Folk cook: press B, open Kitchen and place a Stove.
Everyone needs somewhere to sit: press B and add a chair or sofa.

done_text: That is the basics covered. Keep furnishing as your coins allow.
empty_tips: This home is empty: your Folk will sleep on the floor and order in snacks until you furnish it. Press B to open Build / Buy.
Step one: buy a bed. Open Bedroom in the Build / Buy panel, pick a bed and click a spot in the bedroom.
Step two: a toilet, then a fridge. The Next Step note at the top-right tells you what to buy next.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Take your time: nobody is going hungry while you shop.
fallbacks_note: Autonomy fallbacks live in data/interactions.json: sleep_floor (existing), welcome_snack, cafe_restroom.
